messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, you like fishing, eh,
{04 1f 00}? {01 00 00 05 00}Think you're,
like, the fish master?
{07 14 00}Because I'll bet you I can
catch a fish that's more
rare than any you catch!
{07 00 00}Here's the deal.{01 00 00 05 00} You and I
each catch a fish that's
not really in season now.
Then, we'll figure out who's
caught the more rare fish.{01 01 00}
{07 0b 00}Does that sound good?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Sulle meeldib kalastada,
{04 1f 00}? {01 00 00 05 00}Arvad, et oled
nagu kalameister?
{07 14 00}Sest vean kihla, et püüan
kala, mis on haruldasem
kui ükski sinu püütud!
{07 00 00}Tehing on selline.{01 00 00 05 00} Sina ja
mina püüame kumbki kala,
mis pole praegu hooajal.
Siis selgitame välja, kes
püüdis haruldasema kala.{01 01 00}
{07 0b 00}Kas see kõlab hästi?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I hear you're good at
catching fish, {04 1f 00}.

But do you just catch
any old fish, or {07 0b 00}do you
have a good eye for 'em?
{07 00 00}Here's a little test.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} We
each catch a fish, and we'll
see which is rarer.
Try to catch a fish that's
not in season right now,{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 19 00}and bring it to me.
{07 0b 00}How does that sound?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma kuulen, et sa oled hea
kalapüüdja, {04 1f 00}.

Aga kas sa püüad lihtsalt
suvalist kala või {07 0b 00}on sul
nende jaoks hea silm?
{07 00 00}Siin on väike test.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Me
püüame kumbki kala ja
vaatame, kumb haruldasem.
Proovi püüda kala, mis pole
praegu hooajal,{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 19 00}ja too see mulle.
{07 0b 00}Kuidas see kõlab?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I've been having a real
string of good luck
catching fish lately.
{07 04 00}Oh! {01 00 00 05 00}So you think you can
outfish me, do you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}All right, let's have a
little contest, shall we?{01 00 00 05 00}
Just you and me.
Catch something, and {07 19 00}I'll
judge whose fish is more
rare.{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}Does that sound fair?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Mul on viimasel ajal olnud
tõeline õnneseeria
kalapüügis.
{07 04 00}Oh! {01 00 00 05 00}Nii et sa arvad, et
suudad mind üle kalastada,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 00 00}Hea küll, teeme väikese
võistluse, eks?{01 00 00 05 00}
Ainult sina ja mina.
Püüa midagi ja {07 19 00}ma hindan,
kelle kala on
haruldasem.{01 01 00} {07 0b 00}Kas see on aus?
